reason: The selected live slice crosses movement admission, pickup/check_here state, invent.c look_here output, and tty menu-shaped text rendering/input. The current port refuses the pile before movement and has no NHW_MENU-with-data owner, so the full transaction through dismissal and the next prompt is missing.

boundary.startingEvent: A sighted, unswallowed hero begins an uncounted one-square walk onto an ordinary ROOM or CORR square holding two to four ordinary nameable objects, with flags.pickup false, the default pile_limit of 5, and no trap, region, engraving, terrain feature, pool, lava, or touchable cockatrice corpse.
boundary.endingEvent: The hero has moved, any run has stopped, the Things that are here window has listed the objects in floor-chain order, the player has dismissed its (end) prompt, tty has repaired the covered map and message area, and the game is waiting for the next hero command.
boundary.validInputs: Two, three, and four ordinary objects on ROOM or CORR; a space or Escape dismissal; ordinary walking and a movement reached while context.run is nonzero; default pile_limit 5 and flags.pickup false; object names that exercise ordinary and over-column-width tty storage.
boundary.observables: Exact input waits, random-number log, complete 24x80 cells and attributes, cursor positions, hero and floor-object state, floor-chain order, run and multi state, message-window state, tty repair, inventory, and persisted storage through the next prompt.
boundary.exclusions: Automatic or interactive pickup; pile_limit count output including pile_limit 0 or 1; decorated, furniture, doorway, pool, lava, region, trap, engraving, blind, swallowed, and cockatrice-touch cases; object actions after the ending prompt. Every reachable excluded family must still fail closed before its first unowned effect.
